instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: So you remember we made that green E with the red thing in the middle. We want to make the same thing again. But this time it's going to be facing, the E is going to be facing you. So on the right side of the grid, you place the green block with the short side facing you. And you take the red thing and now you place it on the top right corner on top of the green block. And then on top of that you place another green block in exactly the same orientation that you put it at the bottom. So now you have an E that goes like this. It's facing you instead of facing away.

assumptions: The first green block, being 4 units long, is placed at x=0 spanning the entire grid, with 'on the right side of the grid' referring to the placement of the red block on its right end.
The top green block is aligned with the bottom green block (x=0, z=0) to complete the C-shape.
evidence: So on the right side of the grid, you place the green block with the short side facing you.
And you take the red thing and now you place it on the top right corner on top of the green block.
And then on top of that you place another green block in exactly the same orientation that you put it at the bottom.
So now you have an E that goes like this. It's facing you instead of facing away.
